title: meliosma pinnata subsp. ridleyi
intro: Meliosma pinnata subsp. ridleyi, commonly known as the Malay tea or tea shrub, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include its ability to aid in digestion and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Meliosma pinnata subsp. ridleyi include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help in wound healing and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
